capabilities.label: Source Known
capabilities.description: A source is represented by reviewed registry metadata.

capabilities.label: Catalog Indexed
capabilities.description: A catalog or list of source records can be represented.

capabilities.label: Metadata Indexed
capabilities.description: Metadata records can be represented.

capabilities.label: Representation Indexed
capabilities.description: Representation/member metadata can be represented.

capabilities.label: Content Indexed
capabilities.description: Content/text/OCR/manifest information can be represented after extraction policy.

capabilities.label: Action Indexed
capabilities.description: Safe actions can be represented after action policy.

capabilities.label: Has Documented API
capabilities.description: Source documents an API or endpoint contract.

capabilities.label: Supports Identifier Lookup
capabilities.description: Source can look up a known identifier under policy.

capabilities.label: Supports Search
capabilities.description: Source exposes a search mechanism under policy.

capabilities.label: Supports Pagination
capabilities.description: Source search/listing supports pages.

capabilities.label: Supports Bulk Dump
capabilities.description: Source offers a metadata dump or bulk export under policy.

capabilities.label: Supports Metadata Record Fetch
capabilities.description: Source can provide a metadata record for a known id.

capabilities.label: Supports File Listing
capabilities.description: Source metadata may list files without granting download permission.

capabilities.label: Supports Member Listing
capabilities.description: Source metadata may list members or representations.

capabilities.label: Supports Hashes
capabilities.description: Source metadata may include hashes.

capabilities.label: Supports Release Assets
capabilities.description: Source metadata may describe release assets.

capabilities.label: Supports Reviews Or Notes
capabilities.description: Source metadata may include user or maintainer notes.

capabilities.label: Supports Compatibility Notes
capabilities.description: Source may include compatibility notes.

capabilities.label: Supports OAI-PMH
capabilities.description: Source may support OAI-PMH metadata harvesting under policy.

capabilities.label: Supports IIIF
capabilities.description: Source may support IIIF manifests under policy.

capabilities.label: Supports CDX
capabilities.description: Source may support CDX capture metadata under policy.

capabilities.label: Supports RSS Atom Sitemap
capabilities.description: Source may expose RSS, Atom, or sitemap metadata under policy.

capabilities.label: Supports Directory Listing
capabilities.description: Source may expose directory listings under policy.

capabilities.label: Supports Auth Required Access Future
capabilities.description: Source may require authenticated access in a future reviewed lane.

capabilities.label: Supports Local Only Import
capabilities.description: Source can be represented from local user-supplied data under privacy policy.

capabilities.label: Supports Restricted Manifest Only
capabilities.description: Restricted source is represented only by manifest metadata.
